4861.title: Configured Codex model is absent from default selection
4861.rootCauseOneLine: The Codex bridge forwards catalog default flags without consulting effective configuration; the server chooses that flag for unresolved project defaults.
4861.proposedFix: Read and validate config.model on the existing model-list connection, prefer a matching listed model, and retain catalog defaults when configuration cannot supply a match.
4861.caveats: Reproduced at the real bridge boundary using a repository-owned hermetic subprocess, not a native Codex/account run. Account-specific rejection remains unverified. The same agent performed both clean reproductions.
